card.name: First digit of durations and intervals
card.fires_on: The first digit (or the space before it) of a number of days, weeks, months or hours, where the number may continue as a two-digit value like 12, 17 or 28. It fires in dosing schedules and study durations.

modes.label: First digit of teen/tens numbers
modes.description: A leading digit such as 1 or 2 that is followed by another digit before a time unit.

modes.description: A space or the word one placed right before a number of days or weeks.
